source_title: What I Learned From A Digital Products

snippets.snippet_text: "I confessed that in three years on Gumroad, I've made a grand total of $139.96. I have a free ebook on ghostwriting that seven people downloaded. A paid guide on pitching that maybe ten people bought, and a free short story set at a Catholic school in Amman, Jordan, that some downloaded."

intake_notes: Substack article (November 12, 2025). Individual Gumroad seller: $139.96 total revenue in 3 years from low-volume product catalog (writing guides, ebooks).
possible_subjects: Gumroad seller: $139.96 total revenue over 3 years from writing guides/ebooks with minimal marketing
